decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because the records show two separate purchases, not one purchase charged twice. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 11 days after the disputed posting on 2026-10-14. That is well inside the 120-day limit (time-limits). The card has two purchases at HARBOUR MARKET (MER-000064), each for 9476 minor units (94.76 EUR). TXN-008003 was made at 2026-10-12T20:16:14Z and posted on 2026-10-13 under authorisation AUTH-008202, which was approved by chip and PIN. TXN-008004 was made at 2026-10-13T04:16:14Z and posted on 2026-10-14 under authorisation AUTH-008203, which was approved contactless. The two postings do not share an authorisation, were made about 8 hours apart and used different entry methods. Neither authorisation carries a fraud flag, and the ledger shows no refund from this merchant. Under duplicate-separate-authorisations, two postings with their own authorisations made some time apart are two purchases, even when the merchant and amount are the same, so the dispute is declined.
